# 1. Early vs Late RG
## (1) ArchR_RG
```{r}
load("./data_rda/Script3/ArchR_EHB_5ct.rda")
ArchR_EHB_RG <- ArchR_EHB_5ct[ArchR_EHB_5ct$ctAnnot_2.0=="Radial glia",]
rm(ArchR_EHB_5ct)
ArchR_EHB_RG # 30,183 RG cells

ArchR_EHB_RG$Stage <- stri_replace_all_regex(ArchR_EHB_RG$Age, pattern = c("CS14","CS16","CS17","CS20","CS21"), 
                                             replacement = c("Early","Early","Late","Late","Late"), vectorise_all = FALSE)
save(ArchR_EHB_RG, file = "./data_rda/Script5/ArchR_EHB_RG.rda")
```


## (2) differential genes + GO
```{r}
# down-sample to 2000
table(ArchR_EHB_RG$Stage[ArchR_EHB_RG$Region=="Forebrain"])
table(ArchR_EHB_RG$Stage[ArchR_EHB_RG$Region=="CerebellumPons"])
table(ArchR_EHB_RG$Stage[ArchR_EHB_RG$Region=="Medulla"])

# differential analysis (split region) ~ 1.2 min
set.seed(100)
DAG_RG_early <- list()
DAG_RG_late <- list()
for (x in unique(ArchR_EHB_RG$Region)){
  DA_RG_genes <- getMarkerFeatures(ArchR_EHB_RG[ArchR_EHB_RG$Region==x,], useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix", 
                                   groupBy = "Stage", useGroups = "Early", bgdGroups = "Late",
                                   bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"), testMethod = "wilcoxon", k = 100, maxCells = 2000)
  DAG_RG_early[[x]] <- data.frame(getMarkers(DA_RG_genes, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC >= 0.6"))
  DAG_RG_late[[x]] <- data.frame(getMarkers(DA_RG_genes, cutOff = "FDR <= 0.01 & Log2FC <= -0.6"))
  rm(x, DA_RG_genes)
}
```

```{r}
# GO enrichment ~ 1.2 min
GO_early <- list()
GO_late <- list()
for (x in names(DAG_RG_early)){
  GO_early[[x]] <- enrichGO(DAG_RG_early[[x]]$name, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL", pAdjustMethod = "BH", ont = "ALL")
  GO_early[[x]]@result$region <- x
  GO_early[[x]]@result$group <- "early"
  
  GO_late[[x]] <- enrichGO(DAG_RG_late[[x]]$name, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL", pAdjustMethod = "BH", ont = "ALL")
  GO_late[[x]]@result$region <- x
  GO_late[[x]]@result$group <- "late"
  
  rm(x)
}
```


### supp fig - GO early
```{r}
# remove duplicated GO, keeping the first
GO_early_summary <- rbind(GO_early[[1]]@result, GO_early[[2]]@result, GO_early[[3]]@result)
result <- GO_early_summary %>% arrange(p.adjust)
result <- dplyr::distinct(result, ID, .keep_all = TRUE) 
row.names(result) <- result$ID

# select top 10 GO per region
result <- result %>% group_by(region) %>% slice(1:10)
result <- as.data.frame(result)

# prepare tree plot
trial <- GO_early[[1]]
trial@result <- result
#semData <- godata('org.Hs.eg.db', keytype = "ENTREZID", ont = "BP", computeIC = TRUE) # the same for BP/MF/CC
GO <- pairwise_termsim(trial, method = "Wang", semData = semData)   # using the Wang similarity

# look at the dendrogram and manually set a number for ncluster
p <- treeplot(GO, showCategory=nrow(GO), fontsize=4, cluster.params = list(n = 4), cex_category = 0)
p
```

```{r}
# extract clustering order
trial <- data.frame(p$data)
trial <- trial[!is.na(trial$label),1:10]
result$Description <- factor(result$Description, levels=trial$label[order(trial$y)])
result$region <- factor(result$region, levels = c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons","Medulla"))

# dot plot
ggplot(result, aes(x=region, y=Description, colour=region, size=p.adjust, shape=ONTOLOGY)) + 
    geom_point() + scale_y_discrete() + DOSE::theme_dose() + 
    scale_colour_manual(values=c(Forebrain="#FDE333", CerebellumPons="#53CC67", Medulla="#009B95")) + 
    xlab("") + ylab("") + ggtitle("Early > Late") +
    scale_size(trans = 'reverse', range=c(2,6)) + 
    guides(colour = guide_legend(title="stage", override.aes = list(size = 4), order = 1), 
           size = guide_legend(title="p.adjust", size = 2, order = 2), 
           shape = guide_legend(title="GO category", size=2, override.aes = list(size = 4), order = 3)) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5), text=element_text(size=14))
```

# 2. RG Seurat
## (1) prepare Seurat
```{r}
# get gene scores ~ 1 min
load("./data_rda/Script5/ArchR_EHB_RG.rda")
gene_score_matrix <- getMatrixFromProject(ArchR_EHB_RG, useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix")

# create Seurat object
gene_scores <- assay(gene_score_matrix)
gene_scores <- as.matrix(gene_scores)
rownames(gene_scores) <- gene_score_matrix@elementMetadata@listData[["name"]]
seurat_RG <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = gene_scores, assay = "ATAC")

# add metadata
seurat_RG <- AddMetaData(seurat_RG, metadata = as.data.frame(colData(gene_score_matrix)))
rm(gene_score_matrix, gene_scores)
gc()

# scale data
## no need to run NormalizeData(), keep gene score - already normalised
seurat_RG <- ScaleData(seurat_RG, layer = "counts")  # layer = "data"
seurat_RG # 24961 genes, 22311 cells
## no need to run FindVariableFeatures(), use all genes, because top variable genes are too noisy (non-coding RNA)
```

```{r}
set.seed(100)

# PCA ~ 3 min
seurat_RG <- RunPCA(seurat_RG, features = rownames(seurat_RG))
ElbowPlot(seurat_RG)

# batch correction ~ 20s
seurat_RG@meta.data[["batch"]] <- "scATAC"
seurat_RG@meta.data[["batch"]][seurat_RG@meta.data[["ID"]] == "FB-16"] <- "multiome"
seurat_RG <- RunHarmony(object = seurat_RG, group.by.vars = "batch")

# UMAP ~ 15s
seurat_RG <- RunUMAP(seurat_RG, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony", spread = 0.5)
```

### supp fig - PERMANOVA
```{r}
# extract UMAP coordiniates
UMAP_coord <- as.data.frame(seurat_RG@reductions[["umap"]]@cell.embeddings)
sum(row.names(UMAP_coord) == names(seurat_RG@active.ident)) == nrow(UMAP_coord)
UMAP_coord$Age <- seurat_RG$Age
UMAP_coord$Region <- seurat_RG$Region

# compare ages
comparison <- data.frame(group1=c("CS14","CS16","CS17","CS20"), group2=c("CS16","CS17","CS20","CS21"))

# downsample to 150
min(table(UMAP_coord[,c("Age","Region")]))

# PERMANOVA with random down-sampling: seed=123, downsample=150
set.seed(123)
results <- data.frame()
for (x in 1:nrow(comparison)){
  for (y in c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons","Medulla")){
    UMAP_coord_down <- UMAP_coord %>% filter(Region == y) %>% 
      group_by(Age) %>% filter(Age %in% comparison[x,]) %>% 
      sample_n(min(150, n()), replace = FALSE) # downsample for each age and region, n=100
    dist_matrix <- dist(UMAP_coord_down[,1:2]) # compute Euclidean distance
    test <- vegan::adonis2(dist_matrix ~ Age, data = UMAP_coord_down, permutations = 999) # PERMANOVA
    results <- rbind(results, c(comparison[x,], region=y, R2=test$R2[1], p=test$`Pr(>F)`[1]))  
  }
  rm(x, y, UMAP_coord_down, dist_matrix, test)
}
```

```{r}
library(ggraph)

# forebrain
trial <- results[results$region=="Forebrain",]
names(trial)[1:2] <- c("source","target")
ggraph(trial, layout="linear") +
  geom_edge_arc(edge_colour=rep(c(CS14="#704D9E", CS16="#BC5AA9", CS17="#ED7C97", CS20="#f79452"), each=100), 
                edge_alpha=0.5, edge_width=5*rep(trial$R2/max(trial$R2),each=100)) +
  geom_node_point(color=c(CS14="#704D9E", CS16="#BC5AA9", CS17="#ED7C97", CS20="#f79452", CS21="#f2de5c"), size=5) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label=name), size=8, nudge_y=-0.03,
                 color=c(CS14="#704D9E", CS16="#BC5AA9", CS17="#ED7C97", CS20="#f79452", CS21="#f2de5c")) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label=c(paste0("R^2=\n", round(trial$R2,4)),"")),
                 size=8, nudge_y=0.2, nudge_x=0.5, 
                 color=c(CS14="#704D9E", CS16="#BC5AA9", CS17="#ED7C97", CS20="#f79452", CS21="#f2de5c")) +
  theme_void()
```

## (3) ctAnnot
### clustering
```{r}
# find clusters
set.seed(123)
seurat_RG <- FindNeighbors(seurat_RG, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:16, k.param=50)
seurat_RG <- FindClusters(seurat_RG, resolution = 0.8, cluster.name = "clusters_0.8")
seurat_RG <- FindClusters(seurat_RG, resolution = 1, cluster.name = "clusters_1.0")
seurat_RG <- FindClusters(seurat_RG, resolution = 1.2, cluster.name = "clusters_1.2")
seurat_RG <- FindClusters(seurat_RG, resolution = 1.5, cluster.name = "clusters_1.5")
```

```{r}
# clustree: select the best resolution
library(clustree)
clustree_df <- cbind("1", seurat_RG$clusters_0.8, seurat_RG$clusters_1.0, seurat_RG$clusters_1.2, seurat_RG$clusters_1.5)
colnames(clustree_df) <- paste0("resolution", c(0, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 1.5))
clustree(clustree_df, prefix = "resolution") +
  guides(edge_colour = "none", edge_alpha = "none", size = "none") +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 14), legend.title = element_text(size = 16), legend.position = "right")
rm(clustree_df)
```

### ct markers
```{r}
# ct marker UMAP
## - HOPX: oRG
## - CRYAB: truncated RG
## - ZEB2: transitioning NE-RG
## - SOX2/PAX6: high in NE
## - LMNB1/2: high in early NE
## - HES1: high in NE and vRG
## - NFIX: high in oRG
## - TNC/VIM: RG scaffold & fibre
## - PROM1: apical RG
ctMarkers <- c("HOPX","CRYAB","ZEB2","SOX2","PAX6","LMNB1","LMNB2","HES1","NFIX","TNC","VIM","PROM1")

FeaturePlot(seurat_RG, features = ctMarkers, max.cutoff = 2, ncol = 3) + coord_fixed()
```

```{r}
# cluster and ct markers, ordered by logFC
cluster_markers_ct <- cluster_markers[cluster_markers$gene %in% ctMarkers,]
cluster_markers_ct <- cluster_markers_ct[order(cluster_markers_ct$p_val_adj),]

# cluster marker table
cluster_info <- data.frame()
for (x in unique(cluster_markers$cluster)){
  # regional info
  regions <- seurat_RG$Region[seurat_RG$clusters_1.2 == x]
  cluster_info <- rbind(cluster_info, 
                        c(x, sum(seurat_RG$clusters_1.2 == x), # cell count
                        round(mean(as.numeric(sub("CS","",seurat_RG$Age[seurat_RG$clusters_1.2 == x]))),2), # avg age
                        paste0(names(which.max(table(regions))), " (", round(max(table(regions)) / length(regions),3), ")"), # region
                        paste(cluster_markers_ct$gene[cluster_markers_ct$cluster == x], collapse = " | "))) # ctMarkers
  rm(x, regions)
}
names(cluster_info) <- c("cluster","cell count","mean age","main region (proportion)","cell type markers")
```

### ct annotation
```{r}
# import annotation
ctAnnot <- readxl::read_excel("./data_output/Script5_ctAnnotation/ctAnnot_ATAC_RG.xlsx", sheet = 1)
ctAnnot <- ctAnnot[,c("Cluster","Subtype")]
ctAnnot$Cluster <- paste0("C",ctAnnot$Cluster)

# add cell type annotations
seurat_RG$fix <- paste0("C",seurat_RG$clusters_1.2)
seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG <- stri_replace_all_regex(seurat_RG$fix,
                              pattern = ctAnnot$Cluster[!ctAnnot$Cluster %in% c("C1")], 
                              replacement = ctAnnot$Subtype[!ctAnnot$Cluster %in% c("C1")],
                              vectorize = FALSE)
seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG <- stri_replace_all_regex(seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG, 
                              pattern = ctAnnot$Cluster, 
                              replacement = ctAnnot$Subtype,
                              vectorize = FALSE)
rm(ctAnnot)

# UMAP
seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG <- factor(seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG, levels = c("tRG", "oRG", "vRG","tNE"))
DimPlot(seurat_RG, reduction = "umap", group.by = c("ctAnnot_RG"),
        cols = c(tNE="#463C91",vRG="#5E4CE6",oRG="#9E8FFF",tRG="#BFB6FA")) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) + 
  theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank())
```

```{r}
# ct trend plot
annot_summary <- data.frame()
for (x in unique(seurat_RG$Age)){
  for (y in unique(seurat_RG$Region)){
    for (z in unique(seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG)){
      n <- sum(seurat_RG$Age==x & seurat_RG$Region==y & seurat_RG$ctAnnot_RG==z)
      p <- n/sum(seurat_RG$Age==x & seurat_RG$Region==y)
      annot_summary <- rbind(annot_summary, c(x,y,z,n,p))
    }
  }
  rm(x,y,z,n,p)
}
names(annot_summary) <- c("Age", "Region", "Subtype", "nCell", "Proportion")
annot_summary$nCell <- as.numeric(annot_summary$nCell)
annot_summary$Proportion <- as.numeric(annot_summary$Proportion)
annot_summary$Region <- factor(annot_summary$Region, levels=c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons","Medulla"))
annot_summary$Subtype <- factor(annot_summary$Subtype, levels = c("tRG", "oRG", "vRG","tNE"))
annot_summary$Age <- as.numeric(sub("CS","",annot_summary$Age))

# plot
ggplot(annot_summary, aes(x=Age, y=Proportion, fill=Subtype, pattern = Subtype)) + 
  facet_wrap(~Region) + geom_area() +
  xlab("Carnegie Stage") + BuenColors::pretty_plot() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(14,16,17,20,21), labels = c("CS14", "CS16", "CS17", "CS20", "CS21")) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1), 
        legend.title = element_blank(), legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(tNE="#463C91",vRG="#5E4CE6",oRG="#9E8FFF",tRG="#BFB6FA"))
```

# 3. hdWGCNA
Gene co-accessibility networks
GitHub for R package: https://github.com/smorabit/hdWGCNA/tree/dev
Tutorials list: https://smorabit.github.io/hdWGCNA/articles/hdWGCNA.html
Key tutorials I followed in this script:
  - hdWGCNA in single-cell data: https://smorabit.github.io/hdWGCNA/articles/basic_tutorial.html
  - Network Visualization: https://smorabit.github.io/hdWGCNA/articles/network_visualizations.html
Project RNA-seq to ATAC-seq: 
  - hdWGCNA tutorial: https://smorabit.github.io/hdWGCNA/articles/projecting_modules_cross.html
  - hdWGCNA paper: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10326379/?utm_source=chatgpt.com

## (1) hdWGCNA
### run WGCNA
```{r
# use the 2000 variable genes for WGCNA, no ZEB2 >>> saved as "seurat_RG_var2000"
```

```{r}
# set up the co-expression matrix
```

## (2) differential accessibility
```{r}
# get colour ref
modules <- GetModules(seurat_RG) %>% subset(module != 'grey')
colour_ref <- unique(modules[,2:3])
row.names(colour_ref) <- NULL
colour_ref$module <- sub("_","-",colour_ref$module)

# differential accessible MODULES, split region
p <- list()
summary <- list()
for (y in c("CS16_CS14", "CS17_CS16")){
  for (x in unique(seurat_RG@meta.data$Region)){
    DME <- FindDMEs(seurat_RG, test.use='wilcox',
                    barcodes1 = seurat_RG@meta.data %>% subset(Age==sub("_.*","",y) & Region==x) %>% rownames,
                    barcodes2 = seurat_RG@meta.data %>% subset(Age==sub(".*_","",y) & Region==x) %>% rownames)
    DME <- DME[order(DME$avg_log2FC),]
    DME$module <- factor(DME$module, levels = DME$module)
    DME$result <- "non-significant"
    DME$result[DME$p_val_adj < 0.01 & DME$avg_log2FC >= 0.6] <- "hyper-accessible"
    DME$result[DME$p_val_adj < 0.01 & DME$avg_log2FC <= -0.6] <- "hypo-accessible"
    DME$colour <- colour_ref$color[order(match(colour_ref$module, DME$module))]
    summary[[x]] <- DME
    
    x <- stri_replace_all_regex(x, pattern = c("Forebrain","Medulla","CerebellumPons"), 
                                replacement = c("FB","MD","CP"), vectorize_all = FALSE)
    p[[paste0(x,"_",y)]] <- ggplot(DME, aes(y=module, x=avg_log2FC, size=3, color=module, shape = result)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept=0, color='black') + 
      geom_segment(aes(y=module, yend=module, x=0, xend=avg_log2FC), linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.3) +
      geom_point() + guides(shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)), color = "none", size = "none") +
      scale_shape_manual(values = c("hyper-accessible"=19, "hypo-accessible"=17, "non-significant"=13)) +
      scale_color_manual(values=DME$colour[])  + scale_x_continuous(oob = squish) + BuenColors::pretty_plot() +
      ylab('') + xlab(bquote("Avg. log"[2]~"(Fold Change)")) + 
      ggtitle(paste0(sub("_.*","",y), " vs ", sub(".*_","",y)," in ", x)) +
      theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
            axis.text.y = element_text(size=11), axis.text.x = element_text(size=11),
            legend.position = "none", legend.text = element_text(size = 14))
  }
  rm(x, y, DME)
}
```

## (3) module member genes
### gene groups for each module
```{r}
# get gene locations
load("./data_rda/Script5/ArchR_EHB_RG.rda")
gene_location <- ArchR_EHB_RG@geneAnnotation@listData[["genes"]]

# assign genes into location groups (genes that are within 1000kb of each other are grouped together)
module_genes <- list()
for (x in unique(modules$module)){
  module_genes[[x]] <- as.data.frame(gene_location[gene_location$symbol %in% modules[modules$module==x,]$gene_name])
  module_genes[[x]]$group <- 1
  for (i in 2:nrow(module_genes[[x]])) {
    if (module_genes[[x]]$seqnames[i] == module_genes[[x]]$seqnames[i - 1]) {
      distance <- module_genes[[x]]$start[i] - module_genes[[x]]$end[i - 1]
      if (distance > 1000000) {
        module_genes[[x]]$group[i] <- module_genes[[x]]$group[i - 1] + 1
      } else {
        module_genes[[x]]$group[i] <- module_genes[[x]]$group[i - 1]
      }
    } else {
      module_genes[[x]]$group[i] <- module_genes[[x]]$group[i - 1] + 1
    }
  }  
  rm(x, i, distance)  
}
rm(gene_location)

# how many groups are there in each module?
df <- data.frame()
for (x in names(module_genes)){
  df <- rbind(df, c(x,max(module_genes[[x]]$group)))
  rm(x)
}
names(df) <- c("module","nGroup")
df$module <- factor(df$module, levels=df$module)
df$nGroup <- as.numeric(df$nGroup)

# var2000 - only have one gene group: "Module_1","Module_4","Module_10"
#df[df$nGroup==1,]
summary(df$nGroup) # lowest nGene = 9, good

# plotting
ggplot(df, aes(x=module, y=nGroup, fill=module)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))

rm(df)
```

```{r}
# get gene membership (kME)
for (x in names(module_genes)){
  module_fil <- modules[order(match(modules$gene_name, module_genes[[x]]$symbol)),]
  module_fil <- module_fil[1:length(module_genes[[x]]$symbol),]
  module_genes[[x]]$kME <- module_fil[,paste0("kME_",x)]
  module_genes[[x]] <- module_genes[[x]][order(module_genes[[x]]$kME, decreasing = TRUE),]
  rm(x, module_fil)
}
save(module_genes, file = "./data_rda/Script5/WGCNA_module_genes.rda")
save(modules, file = "./data_rda/Script5/WGCNA_modules.rda")
```


### circular plot
```{r
# keep top 20 genes
module_genes_top <- list()
for (x in names(module_genes)){
  module_genes_top[[x]] <- na.omit(module_genes[[x]][1:20,])
  rm(x)
}

# plotting!
p <- list()
for (x in names(module_genes_top)){
  # add 'empty bar' at the end of each group
  data <- module_genes_top[[x]][,c("symbol","group","kME")]
  to_add <- data.frame(matrix(NA, length(unique(data$group)), ncol(data)))
  colnames(to_add) <- colnames(data)
  to_add$group <- rep(unique(data$group), each=1)
  data <- rbind(data, to_add)
  data <- data %>% arrange(group)
  data$id <- seq(1, nrow(data))
  
  # Get the name and the y position of each label
  label_data <- data
  number_of_bar <- nrow(label_data)
  angle <- 90 - 360 * (label_data$id-0.5) /number_of_bar
  label_data$hjust <- ifelse( angle < -90, 1, 0)
  label_data$angle <- ifelse(angle < -90, angle+180, angle)
   
  # Make the plot
  p[[x]] <- ggplot(data, aes(x=as.factor(id), y=kME, fill=as.factor(group))) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity", alpha=0.8) +
    ylim(-0.2,1) + theme_minimal() + coord_polar() + ggtitle(x) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0, face = "bold"), legend.position = "none", 
          axis.text = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    geom_text(data=label_data, aes(x=id, y=kME+0.08, label=symbol, hjust=hjust), alpha=0.6, size=2, angle=label_data$angle, inherit.aes=FALSE)
  
  rm(x, data, to_add, label_data, number_of_bar, angle)
}
```

```{r}
# ZEB2 module

# top 20 GO for ZEB2 module

# prepare tree plot

semData <- godata('org.Hs.eg.db', keytype = "ENTREZID", ont = "BP", computeIC = TRUE) # the same for BP/MF/CC
```

```{r
# differential analysis comparing adjacent timepoints ~ 3.3 min
comparisons <- c("CS14_CS16", "CS16_CS17", "CS17_CS20", "CS20_CS21")
df <- data.frame()
for (x in comparisons){
  for (y in unique(ArchR_EHB_RG$Region)){
    trial <- getMarkerFeatures(ArchR_EHB_RG[ArchR_EHB_RG$Region==y,], useMatrix = "GeneScoreMatrix", 
                    groupBy = "Age", useGroups = sub("_.*","",x), bgdGroups = sub(".*_","",x),
                    bias = c("TSSEnrichment", "log10(nFrags)"), testMethod = "wilcoxon", k = 100, maxCells = 2000)
    marker <- data.frame(getMarkers(trial, cutOff = "FDR <= 1"))
    df <- rbind(df, cbind(y, x, marker[marker$name=="ZEB2",]))
    
  }
  rm(x, y, trial, marker)
}
names(df)[1:2] <- c("Region","comparison")

# formatting
df$x <- rep(c(1.5, 2.5, 3.5, 4.5),each=3)
df$y <- 14.5
df$y_line <- 12
df$x_start <- df$x - 0.4
df$x_end <- df$x + 0.4
df$Region <- factor(df$Region, levels = c("Forebrain","CerebellumPons","Medulla"))
```

## (5) M18 ~ ZEB2 heatmap
### supp fig - GS-GS heatmap
  
Manually modify and re-run code to get:
  *all cells*: not applying downsample
  *downsample* to 150

downsample <- sample(colnames(fil), min(150,ncol(fil)), replace = FALSE) # downsample to n=150

```{r}
# ZEB2 co-accessible genes (same module)
load("./data_rda/Script5/WGCNA_modules.rda")
genes_ZEB2_coAccess <- modules[modules$module=="Module_18", c("gene_name","module","color","kME_Module_18")]
genes_ZEB2_coAccess <- genes_ZEB2_coAccess[order(genes_ZEB2_coAccess$kME_Module_18, decreasing = TRUE),]
nrow(genes_ZEB2_coAccess) # 175 co-accessible genes, including ZEB2 and ZEB2-AS1
```

```{r}
# GS-GS correlation (should be very high, because they are in the same module)
## this improves upon hdWGCNA (single cell correlation) by grouping age and region

# get gene score for ZEB2 coAccess genes
load("./data_rda/Script5/gene_score_matrix_RG.rda")
load("./data_rda/Script5/ArchR_EHB_RG.rda")
gene_score_matrix_coAccess <- gene_score_matrix[na.omit(match(genes_ZEB2_coAccess$gene_name, rownames(gene_score_matrix))),]
gene_score_matrix_coAccess <- assay(gene_score_matrix_coAccess)
sum(colnames(gene_score_matrix_coAccess) == ArchR_EHB_RG$cellNames) == length(ArchR_EHB_RG$cellNames)
rm(gene_score_matrix)
gc()
```

```{r}
# Spearman's correlation: by age and region
correlation_table_coAccess <- list()
for (x in unique(ArchR_EHB_RG$ID)){
  
  fil <- gene_score_matrix_coAccess[,ArchR_EHB_RG$ID==x] 
  downsample <- sample(colnames(fil), min(150,ncol(fil)), replace = FALSE) # downsample to n=150
  fil <- fil[,downsample]
  
  for (y in rownames(gene_score_matrix_coAccess)){
    out <- cor.test(fil["ZEB2",], fil[y,],method = "spearman")
    out <- data.frame(p_value = out$p.value, coefficient = out$estimate)  # coefficient = Spearman's rho
    correlation_table_coAccess[[x]] <- rbind(correlation_table_coAccess[[x]], out)
  }
  rownames(correlation_table_coAccess[[x]]) <- rownames(gene_score_matrix_coAccess)
  correlation_table_coAccess[[x]] <- correlation_table_coAccess[[x]][rownames(correlation_table_coAccess[[x]]) != "ZEB2",]
  
  correlation_table_coAccess[[x]]$FDR <- p.adjust(correlation_table_coAccess[[x]]$p_value, method = "BH")
  correlation_table_coAccess[[x]]$mlog10FDR <- -log10(correlation_table_coAccess[[x]]$FDR)
  correlation_table_coAccess[[x]]$gene <- rownames(correlation_table_coAccess[[x]])
  correlation_table_coAccess[[x]]$sample <- x  
  
  rm(x, y, fil)
}

# summary
correlation_summary_coAccess <- do.call(rbind, correlation_table_coAccess)
rownames(correlation_summary_coAccess) <- NULL
correlation_summary_coAccess$correlation <- "non-significant"
correlation_summary_coAccess$correlation[correlation_summary_coAccess$FDR <= 0.01 & correlation_summary_coAccess$coefficient > 0] <- "positive"
correlation_summary_coAccess$correlation[correlation_summary_coAccess$FDR <= 0.01 & correlation_summary_coAccess$coefficient < 0] <- "negative"
correlation_summary_coAccess <- correlation_summary_coAccess[order(correlation_summary_coAccess$FDR),]
correlation_summary_coAccess$region <- sub("-.*","",correlation_summary_coAccess$sample)
correlation_summary_coAccess$age <- paste0("CS",sub(".*-","",correlation_summary_coAccess$sample))
#save(correlation_summary_coAccess, file = "./data_rda/Script5/correlation_summary_coAccess.rda")
```

```{r}
#load("./data_rda/Script5/correlation_summary_coAccess.rda")

# filter: module membership > 20%
fil <- correlation_summary_coAccess[!grepl("ZEB2",correlation_summary_coAccess$gene),]
fil <- fil[fil$gene %in% genes_ZEB2_coAccess$gene_name[genes_ZEB2_coAccess$kME_Module_18 > 0.25],]
fil$sig <- ifelse(fil$correlation=="non-significant", "", "*")

# cluster rows
mat <- tidyr::pivot_wider(fil[,c("sample","gene","coefficient")], names_from = sample, values_from = coefficient) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("gene") %>% as.matrix()
row_clust <- hclust(dist(mat))
fil <- fil %>% mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = row_clust$labels[row_clust$order]))
fil$region <- factor(fil$region, levels = c("FB","CP","MD"))
fil$gene <- factor(fil$gene, levels=genes_ZEB2_coAccess$gene_name) # order by module membership

# plotting
ggplot(fil, aes(x=age, y=gene, fill=coefficient)) +
  geom_tile() + xlab("") + ylab("") + BuenColors::pretty_plot() + facet_wrap(~region, ncol=3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low="blue",mid="white",high="#EE2211") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,hjust=1), legend.position = "bottom") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig), size = 4, color = "black",nudge_y=-0.3) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev)
```

```{r}
RG_comparison$"Mouse ATAC" <- cbind(summary_mouse_ATAC[summary_mouse_ATAC$Celltype=="Radial Glia", c("Age","geneScore")], "dataset"="mouse cerebellum", "data"="ATAC")

# RNA
RG_comparison$"Human RNA" <- cbind(summary_human_RNA[summary_human_RNA$Celltype=="All radial glia", c("Age","Expression")], "dataset"="human telencephalon", "data"="RNA") # telencephalon, combines RG and neuroepithelial
RG_comparison$"Mouse RNA" <- cbind(summary_mouse_RNA[summary_mouse_RNA$Celltype=="All radial glia", c("Age","Expression")], "dataset"="mouse prospective somatosensory cortex", "data"="RNA") # prospective somatosensory cortex, "All radial glia" combines apical RG (NE-like) and intermediate RG

# combined
names(RG_comparison[[1]])[1:2] <- c("CS","geneScore")
names(RG_comparison[[2]])[1:2] <- c("E","geneScore")
names(RG_comparison[[3]])[1:2] <- c("CS","expression")
names(RG_comparison[[4]])[1:2] <- c("E","expression")

# numeric age
RG_comparison[[1]]$CS <- as.numeric(sub("CS","",RG_comparison[[1]]$CS))
RG_comparison[[2]]$E <- as.numeric(sub("e","",RG_comparison[[2]]$E))
RG_comparison[[3]]$CS <- as.numeric(sub("CS","",RG_comparison[[3]]$CS))
RG_comparison[[4]]$E <- as.numeric(sub("E","",RG_comparison[[4]]$E))
```

```{r}
# human ATAC
p1 <- ggplot(RG_comparison[["Human ATAC"]], aes(x=CS, y=geneScore)) +
      geom_rect(aes(xmin = 16, xmax = 21, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), fill = "pink", alpha = 0.1) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 16, linetype = "dashed", colour = "pink", size = 0.8) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 21, linetype = "dashed", colour = "pink", size = 0.8) +
      geom_line(colour="red",size=1) + 
      BuenColors::pretty_plot() +
      ggtitle("Human ATAC") + ylab("ZEB2 gene score") + xlab("Age (CS)") +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size =11))

# mouse ATAC

      geom_vline(xintercept = 13, linetype = "dashed", colour = "pink", size = 0.8) +
      geom_line(colour="red",size=1) + 
      BuenColors::pretty_plot() +
      ggtitle("Mouse ATAC") + ylab("Zeb2 gene score") + xlab("Age (E)") + 
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size =11))

# human RNA
p3 <- ggplot(RG_comparison[["Human RNA"]], aes(x=CS, y=expression)) +
      geom_rect(aes(xmin = 16, xmax = 22, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), fill = "lightyellow", alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 16, linetype = "dashed", colour = "yellow", size = 0.8) +

# mouse RNA
```
